data.one_liner: Accurate keyboard height and safe-area insets for Flutter native on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides accurate keyboard height and safe-area bottom inset detection, natively on Android and iOS with fallbacks on web and desktop. Includes helper widgets like AnimatedKeyboardPadding and Stream/ValueNotifier APIs to size emoji panels and keep chat composers above the keyboard.
use_when: Building chat applications where composers and sticker panels need to match the keyboard height perfectly.
You need keyboard height before the open animation completely finishes.
avoid_when: Your app only needs basic form layouts where standard MediaQuery.viewInsets is already sufficient.
strengths: Provides keyboard height as soon as the keyboard starts to appear rather than after it settles.
Includes ready-made layout widgets like KeyboardPadding and AnimatedKeyboardPadding.
Offers multiple API styles including Streams, ValueNotifiers, and one-time queries.
weaknesses: Requires disabling default Scaffold resize behavior in certain layouts.
Native implementations are platform-specific to Android and iOS.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and optionally set resizeToAvoidBottomInset: false on Scaffold when using padding widgets.
